provenance.method: Reviewed current NHS 111 Wales eating-disorder overview including ARFID on 2026-09-05.

name: NHS 111 Wales — eating disorders and ARFID
description: NHS Wales overview of eating disorders including ARFID, with public information about restrictive eating and help routes.
intended_use: Wales-specific starting point for eating-disorder/ARFID information without self-diagnosis.
audience_or_context: Wales; people seeking public information about ARFID or other eating-disorder concerns.
limitations: The overview cannot determine whether a person has ARFID or another eating disorder.
Local assessment and treatment routes vary.
ND Oracle does not provide individual nutrition or treatment advice.
